leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the fr unit to define flexible column widths in a CSS Grid layout.
Construct a responsive grid container using display: grid and grid-template-columns.
Configure grid items to span multiple columns using the grid-column property.
Manipulate the distribution of available space by adjusting fr values relative to fixed units.
Integrate the fr unit with other CSS length units to create mixed-layout grids.
Update an existing static grid layout to use fr units for improved flexibility.
Control the visual hierarchy of grid content by strategically applying fractional units.
